title: Amber Orchard Maze
description: Amber Orchard Maze is an original maze game about a harvester gathering amber apples through orchard lanes at sunset. The lanes wind around apple crates and old fences, and a watchful orchard dog patrols the far lanes, always trotting toward the sound of rustling leaves. Every amber apple adds points, and the harvest is complete when the orchard is bare.
body:
Amber Orchard Maze is an original maze game about a harvester gathering amber apples through orchard lanes at sunset. The lanes wind around apple crates and old fences, and a watchful orchard dog patrols the far lanes, always trotting toward the sound of rustling leaves. Every amber apple adds points, and the harvest is complete when the orchard is bare.

The rules are simple: move through the lanes, step on amber apples for ten points each, and avoid the dog, who costs a life and sends you back to the orchard gate if you meet. You have three lives, and the orchard is cleared when every apple is gathered.

Orchard harvesters clear the near rows first and save the far corner for last, when the dog's patrol is predictable. Never enter a dead-end lane while the dog is close, and always leave a second way out. The orchard rewards a calm, planned harvest far more than a hurried dash.
controls: Type up/down/left/right to move, quit to stop.

body:
Willow Wharf Chase is an original maze game about a dockworker chasing loose cargo across a willow-lined wharf at dawn. The wharf lanes run between warehouses and moored boats, and a wharf dog patrols the far lanes, always trotting toward rolling crates. Every crate adds points, and the shift ends when the wharf is clear.

The rules are simple: move through the lanes, step on crates for ten points each, and avoid the dog, who costs a life and sends you back to the wharf gate if you meet. You have three lives, and the wharf is clear when every crate is collected.

Dockworkers clear the near warehouses first and save the far pier for last, when the dog's patrol is predictable. The wharf rewards workers who plan their route before the shift starts, because a crate chased into a dead end is a crate that costs a life.
controls: Type up/down/left/right to move, quit to stop.

title: Zephyr Sky Labyrinth
description: Zephyr Sky Labyrinth is an original maze game about a cloud-walker tracing sky lanes between floating islands, collecting breeze crystals. The lanes arc around cloud banks and windmills, and a sky kite patrols the far lanes, always drifting toward the newest breeze. Every crystal adds points, and the walk ends when the sky is gathered.
body:
Zephyr Sky Labyrinth is an original maze game about a cloud-walker tracing sky lanes between floating islands, collecting breeze crystals. The lanes arc around cloud banks and windmills, and a sky kite patrols the far lanes, always drifting toward the newest breeze. Every crystal adds points, and the walk ends when the sky is gathered.

The rules are simple: move through the lanes, step on crystals for ten points each, and avoid the kite, who costs a life and sends you back to the sky gate if you meet. You have three lives, and the sky is gathered when every crystal is collected.

Cloud-walkers learn the whole sky, not just one lane through it. The lanes that look like shortcuts often end at cloud banks with no exit, while the long way around always stays open. Walk the long way, gather steadily, and the sky belongs to the patient.
controls: Type up/down/left/right to move, quit to stop.
